title: feat(nm2simy): simultaneous M and O at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis opposite seed, y-probes, simultaneous: M and O are disjoint at every probe, hold/hold - including at D where axis-cover FAILs. Concrete witness that signed-letter disjointness is strictly weaker than unsigned complementary cover.
